set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create dedicated system user =="

fi
id inventory

echo "== STEP 2: create confined data directory =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chown inventory:inventory /var/lib/inventory
sudo -n chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory
ls -ld /var/lib/inventory

echo "== STEP 3: install worker script =="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh >/dev/null <<'WORKER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
LOG_FILE="$DATA_DIR/inventory.log"
while true; do
  printf '%s inventory-worker heartbeat pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$$" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 5
done
WORKER_EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== STEP 4: install systemd unit (RHEL7 / systemd 219 syntax) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker (sandboxed)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure
User=inventory
Group=inventory

# Sandboxing: no privilege escalation, filesystem confined to /var/lib/inventory
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadOnlyDirectories=/var
ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF
